name: Sister Scheme 3
source:
Chihaya has a beautiful older sister Akane, who is very popular among the boys at the school. She loves him greatly as a younger brother, but he thought that they should not have romantic feelings for each other. However, he was unable to get a girlfriend, either because of his standards possibly being elevated due to his older sister or that others viewed them as a couple. He did not give up on his dream, but one day, he received a letter which threatened to divulge his secret if he didn’t deeply kiss his older sister at school within two days.

Surprisingly at that time, his childhood friend who had moved away, Sayumi, appeared before him. Her father had remarried his mother, so she would now be living with him, to his astonishment. This change of circumstances caused much tension between him and his older sister. What was the origin of the threatening letter and what will happen to his love life from now on?

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2014/12/18/december-2014-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
千早有一个美丽的姐姐茜，在学校里很受男生欢迎。她非常疼爱他这个弟弟，但他却认为他们不应该有浪漫的感情。然而，他一直没能找到女朋友，要么是因为姐姐的原因，让他的标准提高了，要么是因为别人把他们视为情侣。他并没有放弃自己的梦想，但有一天，他收到了一封信，威胁说如果他两天之内不在学校深吻姐姐，他的秘密就会泄露。

令人惊讶的是，就在这时，他已经搬走的青梅竹马沙由美出现在了他的面前。她的父亲已经与他的母亲再婚，所以她现在和他住在一起，这让他惊讶不已。这种情况的变化使他和姐姐之间的关系变得非常紧张。这封恐吓信的由来是什么？今后他的感情生活又会发生什么变化呢？

[来自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2014/12/18/december-2014-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri！[/url]]
